data.name: Shotgun Rogue
data.detailed_description:
SCREENSHOTS ARE FROM VERY EARLY DEVELOPMENT.

Lock, load, and hold the line. Shotgun Rogue is a fast-paced roguelite survival shooter where every run pushes you deeper into chaos. Waves of relentless enemies are coming for your home, and it’s up to you and your ever-growing arsenal to keep them out.

Survive the Onslaught
Face escalating rounds of enemies that swarm, flank, and overwhelm. Each wave is tougher than the last, forcing you to adapt your strategy, upgrade smartly, and stay on your toes.

Defend Your Home Base
Between waves, return to your home and reinforce it with turrets, traps, barricades, and defensive structures. Build the ultimate fortress to keep the horde at bay or watch it crumble under pressure.

Grow Stronger Every Run
Buy weapons, enhance them with powerful upgrades, and unlock passive abilities that stack into wild, game-changing builds. From rapid-fire shotguns to explosive rounds and ricocheting pellets, every run feels unique.

Features

  • Roguelite progression with randomized upgrades

  • Intense wave-based combat

  • Expand and fortify your home with turrets and defenses

  • Fast runs, high replayability, and escalating challenge

Stand your ground, craft your build, and blast your way to survival.
how long can you last in Shotgun Rogue?

data.short_description: Shotgun Rogue is a fast-paced roguelite where you defend your home from waves of enemies. Upgrade weapons, build turrets and traps, and unlock passive abilities each round. Create powerful combos, fortify your base, and survive as long as you can.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (2015 or newer)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris or dedicated GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 (Monterey) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 / Intel i7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon GPU / Dedicated AMD/NVIDIA
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU (NVIDIA/AMD preferred)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan-compatible GPU (NVIDIA GTX 1060 or better)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
